verdict.rationale: SavvyCal has dedicated round-robin/pooling features that distribute meetings across team members either by cycling (equal distribution) or random selection for max availability, explicitly marketed for sales use cases. However, there is no evidence of configurable weighting or priority levels among team members (e.g., unequal load ratios) beyond binary equal/random distribution. Missing for 10: explicit weighted/priority-based distribution controls, admin-configurable ratios per rep, and independent confirmation of fairness enforcement over time.
